name: lingsante-3.1-flash
description:
LingSante-3.1-flash is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model designed to advance capabilities across health and medicine. Built on Ling-3.1-flash, it contains 560 billion total parameters, activates approximately 25 billion parameters per token, and supports context lengths of up to 1 million tokens.
The model is developed through medical continual pretraining, mixed mid-training, supervised fine-tuning, domain-specialized reinforcement learning, and multi-teacher On-Policy distillation. While retaining strong general capabilities in knowledge, reasoning, coding, and tool use, it substantially strengthens four areas: medical knowledge and complex reasoning, professional behavior and communication boundaries, evidence-based retrieval and synthesis, and long-horizon medical workflows involving multi-turn interaction and tool use.
Ling-3.1-flash-Sante is suitable for medical question answering, complex case analysis, clinical document understanding, professional health communication, evidence retrieval and synthesis, and medical agent research. It brings medical reasoning, professional behavior, external evidence acquisition, and long-horizon task execution together within a unified model while preserving competitive general reasoning and agentic capabilities.
zhDescription:
LingSante-3.1-flash 是一个面向健康与医疗场景增强的混合专家模型（MoE）。模型基于 Ling-3.1-flash 构建，总参数量为 560B，每个 Token 激活约 25B 参数，支持最长 1M 上下文。
模型经过医学领域持续预训练、混合中期训练、监督微调、分领域强化学习和多教师 On-Policy 蒸馏，在保持通用知识、推理、代码与工具使用能力的同时，重点增强四个方面的能力：医学知识理解与复杂推理、符合专业边界的医疗沟通与行为决策、面向循证问题的深度检索与证据综合，以及需要多轮交互和工具调用的长程医疗工作流执行。
Ling-3.1-flash-Sante 适用于医学问答、复杂病例分析、临床资料理解、专业健康沟通、医学证据检索与综合，以及医疗 Agent 等研究和应用场景。模型将医学推理、专业行为、外部证据获取和长程任务执行整合到统一模型中，并保持了具有竞争力的通用推理和 Agent 能力。
